title: Ethical Questions in NLP Research: The (Mis)-Use of Forensic Linguistics
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion.
findings: This paper does not analyze or mention religion/faith; its focus is on the legal and ethical implications of using NLP in forensic linguistics.
